rule: A handover is handover_micro, covered and excluded from the 1% weekly gap cap, only when its duration is under 1 second and the level2 sequence numbers and market_trades trade ids are contiguous across the handover. The incoming instance checks those values against the last ones stored in Redis. Otherwise the handover is uncovered and counts toward the 1% cap, the 15-minute cap, and the stale-feed rules, whatever its duration. After a handover, replay the buffered messages in sequence order. Evaluate stops and trade-through fills on each message using the exchange trade timestamp. A crossed stop fills at the first trade at or through it and is tagged handover_micro. If the order or the timestamps cannot be guaranteed, the handover is uncovered and those messages are not applied. Log the handover_micro count per week.
